answer: A convincing sybil defense is vested payouts dripped across many epochs. Each agent stakes a bond and earnings vest linearly over ~100 epochs into a shared reef pool. Flash-farmed fakes collect only the first tiny tranche, forfeiting unvested earnings when abandoned, so attack revenue collapses while honest agents compound. Reputation ages like pigment saturating a surface, leaving a durable echo of sustained participation; each fake needs its own locked bond and months of patience to profit, making sybil attacks a losing investment.
